description: A React component named DetailsViewer that renders detailed views of objects, supporting collapsible sections, formatting of known fields, raw JSON toggle, and agent selection actions.

classes.name: DetailsViewer
classes.description: A reusable React component for displaying structured object details with features like collapsible sections, formatted fields, and copy-to-clipboard functionality.

methods.name: safePretty
methods.description: Returns a pretty-printed JSON string of the payload, with fallback to String conversion.

methods.name: toLabel
methods.description: Converts a key to a formatted label using formatLabel utility.

methods.name: isTimestampLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a timestamp field.

methods.name: isTokenLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a token count field.

methods.name: isDurationLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a duration or latency field.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a duration string, handling seconds and milliseconds.

methods.name: isCurrencyKeyLoose
methods.description: Determines if a key name loosely indicates a currency or cost field.

methods.name: formatValueByKey
methods.description: Formats a value based on its key, applying special formatting for currency, tokens, timestamps, and durations.

methods.name: initialCollapsed
methods.description: Determines if a section should be collapsed based on its depth and collapsedDepth setting.

methods.name: Collapser
methods.description: A React component for collapsible sections with toggle button.

methods.name: renderPrimitiveVal
methods.description: Renders a primitive value with appropriate styling and formatting.

methods.name: extractAgentIdentity
methods.description: Extracts agent ID and name from an object, supporting various possible property names.

methods.name: renderNode
methods.description: Recursively renders a node (object, array, primitive) with support for collapsible arrays and special handling for 'agents' objects.

methods.name: renderEntries
methods.description: Renders object entries as a styled list, prioritizing highlighted keys.
